privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Gap-review checks for the three shared assets
goal: The gap review flags, per project, work that bypasses a shared asset or lacks a recorded skip
acceptance: docs/agents/gap-review.md tells the reviewer to check by hand, per project: a UI component or token that duplicates or is missing from bricks
domain logic used by two or more projects that is not in blocks (propose creating blocks or the package)
a model-facing feature or MCP tool with no Gauntlet case and no recorded skip
each finding becomes a proposal to the owning or shared repository under the existing procedure
if the dashboard or solution tool would need a change, it is written as a proposal to project-harness and no harness file is edited

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed for coordinator-only work; re-estimated the same day for the owner's widened scope. Not a measurement.
